articles.headline: Israel and Iran exchange missile fire threatening Middle East truce
articles.summary: The exchange marked a major escalation in the already tense region. It came on the 100th day of the U.S. and Israel's war with Iran as the heightened tensions further complicated efforts to end Middle East fighting.
articles._summary: Israeli security forces examine a fragment of an intercepted Iranian missile in northern Israel, early Monday, June 8, 2026. Rami Shlush/AP hide caption TEL AVIV — Israel and Iran exchanged missile fire in the first such attacks between the two bitter rivals since a Middle East ceasefire was declared two months ago. The exchange marked a major escalation in the already tense region. But this was only part of increased military action in recent days that has also included the U.S., several Arab Gulf countries and the militant Lebanese group Hezbollah. All the shooting has further complicated efforts to end the war in Iran, which began on Feb. 28 and marked its 100th day on Monday. President Trump says an agreement is within reach — a claim he has made repeatedly in recent weeks. "We are very close to a final deal with Iran. It's is going to be a good deal. I don't want it to blow up because of what is happening now," Trump told Axios on Sunday.
articles._zh_headline: 以色列和伊朗导弹交火威胁中东停战
articles._zh_summary: 2026 年 6 月 8 日星期一早些时候，以色列安全部队在以色列北部检查了一枚被拦截的伊朗导弹碎片。 Rami Shlush/美联社隐藏标题栏特拉维夫——以色列和伊朗之间发生了导弹交火，这是自两个月前宣布中东停火以来这两个宿敌之间的首次此类袭击。此次交锋标志着本已紧张的地区局势进一步升级。但这只是最近几天增加的军事行动的一部分，其中还包括美国、几个阿拉伯海湾国家和黎巴嫩激进组织真主党。所有枪击事件使结束伊朗战争的努力变得更加复杂。这场战争于 2 月 28 日开始，并于周一迎来了第 100 天。特朗普总统表示达成协议是指日可待的——他最近几周多次重申这一说法。 “我们非常接近与伊朗达成最终协议。这将是一项很好的协议。我不希望它因为现在发生的事情而破裂，”特朗普周日告诉 Axios。

articles.headline: S&P 500 Just Triggered A Signal That Has Never Failed Since 1950—Ryan Detrick Says 'My Oh My'
articles.summary: S&P 500 triggers a flawless bull signal. Ryan Detrick utters 'My oh my' as data shows stocks never lower a year later with 40% average gains.
articles._summary: A two-month surge in the S&P 500 index , which was followed by a 2.64% decline on Friday, has triggered a rare, historically flawless bullish signal that could point to massive stock market gains over the next year. The S&P 500 recently logged an explosive advance, climbing more than 19% within a two-month window. Carson Group Chief Market Strategist Ryan Detrick said in an X post that “The S&P 500 just had one of the best two-month rallies ever, as it was up 19.5% in two months on 5/29/06.”

articles._zh_summary: 标准普尔 500 指数连续两个月飙升，随后周五下跌 2.64%，引发了罕见的、历史上完美的看涨信号，可能预示着明年股市将大幅上涨。标准普尔 500 指数最近出现爆炸式上涨，两个月内上涨了 19% 以上。卡森集团首席市场策略师 Ryan Detrick 在 X 帖子中表示，“标准普尔 500 指数刚刚经历了有史以来最好的两个月反弹之一，2006 年 5 月 29 日两个月内上涨了 19.5%。”

articles.headline: Is Gold Losing Its Hedge — When Safe Havens Fail, What's Left?
articles.summary: Gold faces a ultimate test as prices drop 4.3% in June. Is the yellow metal losing its status as the market's top safe haven?
articles._summary: Gold’s reputation as the market’s ultimate safe haven is facing one of its toughest tests in recent times. Since the beginning of June, the yellow metal is down by over 4.3%, hitting an intraday low of $4,268.9 per ounce on Monday. The decline is the aftermath of a stronger-than-expected U.S. nonfarm payrolls report that reignited expectations for higher interest rates. Overall, it is a dramatic round trip for bullion, erasing the entire year’s gain.

articles._zh_summary: 黄金作为市场终极避风港的声誉正面临近年来最严峻的考验之一。自 6 月初以来，黄金已下跌超过 4.3%，周一触及每盎司 4,268.9 美元的盘中低点。此次下跌是由于强于预期的美国非农就业报告重新引发了对加息的预期。总体而言，这对金条来说是一次戏剧性的往返，抹去了全年的涨幅。

articles.headline: Viral DRAM ETF Stock Just Crashed By 20%, Highlighting Key Risk
articles.summary: The viral DRAM ETF stock has just crashed by 20% from its highest point this year, highlighting its diversification risk to investors.
articles._summary: The viral Roundhill Memory ETF (CBOE: DRAM) has been in the spotlight since going public in April this year. Its stock jumped from $28 to $70 as its constituent companies surged. This growth, together with the inflows, pushed its total assets to over $16 billion. DRAM stock ended last week at $55.80, down by over 20% from its highest point on record as investors dumped technology stocks.
articles._zh_headline: Viral DRAM ETF 股票暴跌 20%，凸显关键风险
articles._zh_summary: 自今年 4 月上市以来，备受关注的 Roundhill Memory ETF（CBOE：DRAM）一直备受关注。随着其成分公司股价飙升，其股价从 28 美元跃升至 70 美元。这一增长加上资金流入，使其总资产超过 160 亿美元。由于投资者抛售科技股，DRAM 股价上周收于 55.80 美元，较历史最高点下跌逾 20%。

articles.headline: Bitcoin Price Rally May Be a Dead Cat Bounce as Death Cross Nears and ETF Outflows
articles.summary: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) price is attempting to rebound after falling to a 2024-year low on Saturday. It jumped to $62,230, up modestly from the weekend low of $59,093.
articles._summary: BTC price has been in a strong sell-off in the past few weeks as Wall Street investors continued dumping its ETFs. Data shows that these funds have shed over $5.4 billion in the last four weeks. They now have a cumulative total net inflow of $53.94 billion and hold $75 billion in assets. At Bitcoin's peak, these funds held over $130 billion in assets. There is also a likelihood that some investors have dumped their ETF holdings in anticipation of the upcoming SpaceX IPO .
articles._zh_headline: 随着死亡交叉临近和 ETF 流出，比特币价格上涨可能是死猫反弹
articles._zh_summary: 过去几周，随着华尔街投资者继续抛售 ETF，比特币价格出现大幅抛售。数据显示，这些基金在过去四个星期内损失了超过 54 亿美元。他们目前累计净流入总额为539.4亿美元，持有资产750亿美元。在比特币巅峰时期，这些基金持有超过 1300 亿美元的资产。一些投资者也有可能因预期 SpaceX 即将上市而抛售其持有的 ETF。
